thread:
alex: Kicking off observability stack bootstrap in eu-west-4 today. Goal: logs/metrics/traces + baseline dashboards + alert templates. Need a clean handoff to oncall tomorrow at 09:00 CET. Quick context: new GPU fleet (A100) will land tomorrow and we want basic visibility before traffic ramps.

jia: I'll own dashboard templates and log ingestion paths. One question: for journaling from the GPU pods, do we prefer managed Kafka or an in-cluster topic?

sam: Recommend managed Kafka for now (Confluent in eu-west-4) to avoid ZK ops. We'll create a single topic `redwood-gpu-journal` with 12 partitions to parallelize ingestion. Retention 7d to start. Cost estimate for topic + throughput ~€400-600/mo.

marta: Heads-up on egress: cross-region replication to backups in eu-central will add ~€0.08/GB. If we keep trace exports high we'll hit the budget. Propose initial trace sampling 10% and bump later if needed.

alex: Good call. Tentative architecture: logs -> fluentd (sidecar) -> kafka topic -> log-indexer (es) + s3 archival. Metrics -> node-exporter + kube-state-metrics -> Prometheus -> Cortex remote_write for long term. Traces -> OTLP collector -> Tempo with 10% sampling -> traces backed to s3. Grafana will use Prom/Tempo/ES.

sam: Minimal kube steps to apply (run from infra bastion):
```bash
kubectl --context=eu-west-4 apply -f k8s/observability/namespace.yaml
kubectl --context=eu-west-4 apply -f k8s/observability/fluentd-daemonset.yaml
kubectl --context=eu-west-4 apply -f k8s/observability/otlp-collector.yaml
```
Also set the ES/S3 endpoints after kafka is provisioned:
```bash
kubectl -n observability set env deployment/log-indexer ES_HOST=es.eu4.internal S3_BUCKET=redwood-eu4-logs
```

jia: I'll push the initial dashboard folder to `grafana/dashboards/eu-west-4` and include: GPU utilization (per-card), pod OOMs, batch queue length, request latency p50/p95, prom scrape errors.

marta: Alerts we should seed (templates):
- node:disk_full (warn)
- node:gpu_memory_high (warn)
- pod:oom_kill (critical)
- prom:target_down (critical)
- log:error_rate_spike (warning -> critical escalation)
Include runbook links in the alert annotation.

infra-bot: provision:kafka eu-west-4 -> started at 1923456790
deploy-bot: kafka-topic:create redwood-gpu-journal partitions=12 retention=7d -> OK (topic:k-001) 1923456791

sam: After kafka is up, create the Fluentd connector config to push to the topic. Example connector snippet: 
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: fluentd-kafka-config
data:
  fluent.conf: |
    <match kube.container.logs>
      @type kafka_buffered
      brokers kafka-1:9092,kafka-2:9092
      default_topic redwood-gpu-journal
    </match>
```

jia: Smoke tests planned:
- logs: deploy a test job that writes one log every 5s for 5m; verify it appears in ES and S3 path.
- metrics: run `promtool check` on scrape configs and hit the node exporter endpoints.
- traces: run the sample client generating 50 spans/min, ensure 10% collected by Tempo.
Schedule: smoke window 08:00-08:30 CET tomorrow.

alex: Handoff checklist for oncall:
1) Confirm kafka topic active and offsets moving.
2) ES ingest healthy, shards active.
3) Prometheus targets: >= 95% up.
4) Tempo ingesters have healthy disk space.
5) Grafana dashboards imported and data populating.
6) Alerting templates loaded and test alerts fire to pager.
7) Cost watch: enable budget alerts for log egress > 200GB/day.

marta: Added budget alert to account:billing-alerts rule `obs-egress-eu4`. Notify #finance and #eng-sre.

alex: Risks/notes:
- GPU nodes will push 10-20x more logs during training runs; we may need to increase kafka throughput or enable client-side sampling.
- If ES ingestion lags, fallback is to increase retention to S3-only for older indices and scale the indexer horizontally.
- IAM: ensure kube service accounts have s3:PutObject and kafka:Produce for the fluentd serviceaccount.

sam: I'll drop a minimal IAM policy into `infra/iam/observability-eu4.json` and ping for review.

jia: I'll import dashboards and deploy alert templates after the smoke window. If anyone wants to join the smoke test ping me in thread. :party_parrot:

alex: Thanks all — please update this thread as you make progress. Oncall handoff at 09:00 CET tomorrow (I will be there until 09:15).

marta: I'll cover alerts post-handoff. Good luck, team. :thumbsup:
